features.title: The Vaulted Inbox
features.detail: Your primary email address is shielded behind a cryptographic wall. Only senders on your approved whitelist can reach you. Everyone else is stopped at the gateway.

features.title: Meaningful Custom Suffixes
features.detail: Stop using random strings of gibberish. Create memorable, user-defined suffixes for any scenario, like yourname_shopping. Unlimited, intuitive, and entirely under your control.

features.title: Universal Integration
features.detail: Duotail is non-intrusive by design. It works seamlessly with Gmail, Outlook, or Apple Mail, and even enhances existing privacy services like SimpleLogin or DuckDuckGo.

features.title: On-the-Fly Decryption
features.detail: We don't store your decryption keys. Data is encrypted at rest and keys are generated only when you need them, making your messages virtually data-breach proof.

features.title: Zero-Lock-In Freedom
features.detail: We believe in your right to leave. Download your entire email configuration at any time or deactivate your account with a single click. No questions asked.
